statements.headline: Hazardous Weather Outlook
statements.summary: This afternoon and tonight. A cold front will move slowly south across the region today with showers and a few thunderstorms. There is a Marginal Risk of severe weather, or level 1 out of 5, for damaging wind with a few of these storms this afternoon along and south of the Interstate 70 corridor.

details.label: Today's Hazards
details.text: This afternoon and tonight. A cold front will move slowly south across the region today with showers and a few thunderstorms. There is a Marginal Risk of severe weather, or level 1 out of 5, for damaging wind with a few of these storms this afternoon along and south of the Interstate 70 corridor.

details.label: Extended Outlook
details.text: Thursday through Tuesday. A strong cold front will cross the region Friday with showers and strong wind gusts from 35 to 45 mph. There is a potential for frost and freeze, especially Saturday night, as winds diminish and skies clear.
